programs.title: Information Technology
programs.description: From computer repair to web development, the Information Technology program gives students the practical skills employers need — working in a fully equipped lab under experienced instructors.
whatYouLearn: Digital Media: Content Formats, Video Editing, Graphics
programs.practicalTraining: Students train in a fully equipped computer lab using industry-standard software and hardware, working directly on real computer assembly, networking, and web development tasks alongside certified instructors.

programs.title: Construction & Carpentry
programs.description: From residential carpentry to large-scale construction, this program builds practical skills and safety knowledge for the building industry through intensive, hands-on workshop training.
whatYouLearn: PPE & Site Safety, Power Tool Operation
programs.practicalTraining: Training takes place in a fully equipped workshop covering hand tools, power drills and circular saws, measuring and levelling instruments, and basic welding equipment — always with an emphasis on safety gear (PPE) and site practice.

programs.title: Mechanical & Auto Engineering
programs.description: From engine repair to full vehicle diagnostics, this program gives students hands-on technical skills to work in auto shops, factories, and mechanical workshops.
programs.practicalTraining: Students work in a fully equipped auto-bay with hydraulic lifts and diagnostic computers for modern vehicles, with a hands-on ratio of roughly 60% practical work to 40% theory.

programs.title: Agro-Processing
programs.description: From cashew processing to modern preservation techniques, this program gives students the practical skills to turn raw agricultural produce into profitable, market-ready products.
whatYouLearn: Quality Control, Hygiene & Food Safety Standards
Supply Chain Basics, Marketing & Financial Planning
programs.practicalTraining: Training is centered on a processing and packaging facility where students handle real food preservation, quality control, and agri-business workflows from raw produce through to a market-ready product.

news.title: 2026/2027 Admission Now Open
news.excerpt: Applications are now being accepted for the college's technical and vocational programs.
body: Applications are now being accepted for Stein & Steinmetz College for TVET's technical and vocational programs for the 2026/2027 intake.
Prospective students can choose from Information Technology, Construction & Carpentry, Mechanical & Auto Engineering, and Agricultural Processing.
Complete the application/inquiry form on the Admissions page or contact the college directly to begin the process.

news.title: 4th Annual Graduation Ceremony
news.excerpt: Join the college community in celebrating the achievements of the 2026 cohort.
body: The college community will gather to celebrate the achievements of the 2026 graduating cohort at the 4th Annual Graduation Ceremony.
Family, partners, and members of the public are welcome to attend and celebrate the students' technical and vocational achievements.
Contact the college for details on timing and location, or to RSVP.

news.title: Intro to Solar Panel Installation
news.excerpt: Open to students interested in learning fundamentals of renewable energy and off-grid installation.
body: This workshop is open to students interested in learning the fundamentals of renewable energy and off-grid solar installation.
The session introduces core concepts that complement the college's technical programs and practical training approach.
Register your interest through the contact form to receive more details as they become available.

testimonials.name: Mohamed Kamara
testimonials.quote: After studying IT at SSCTVET, I got a job as a computer technician right here in Pujehun. The practical skills I learned gave me confidence.

testimonials.name: Jenneh Samba
testimonials.quote: I started my own small business processing local cashews after graduating. The college showed me how to turn farming into a profitable industry.

testimonials.name: Alusine Bangura

faqs.question: What programs does SSC for TVET offer?
faqs.answer: The college currently offers Information Technology, Construction & Carpentry, Mechanical & Auto Engineering, and Agro-Processing.

faqs.question: How do I apply?
faqs.answer: Use the application form on the Admissions page, select your course of interest, provide your contact information, and submit your inquiry/application. The college will then follow up with next steps.

faqs.question: Where is the college located?
faqs.answer: The college is located at Mando Farm off Gbondapi Road, Pujehun Town, Pujehun District, Sierra Leone.

faqs.question: How long do the programs take?
faqs.answer: Program duration varies from 6 months to 2 years or 3 years, depending on the certificate or diploma you are applying for.

faqs.question: How can I contact the college?
faqs.answer: Call +232 80 377 218 or +232 78 268 000, email senesiefoday0@gmail.com, or use the application/inquiry form.
